MIND. [1] [Helon.]
Great weakness of memory.
Dull, inactive and gloomy.
Restless, wants to be continually moving about.
Desire to be let alone ; conversation is unpleasant.
Irritable ; cannot endure the least contradiction or receive suggestions in relation to any subject.
Fault finding.
Always better when doing something, when the mind is engaged.
Profound melancholy ; deep, undefined depression of mind.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Helon.]
Dizziness ; fretful ; everything turns in a circle : anemia.
Pain in head is < by stooping, and attended by increased vertigo.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Helon.]
Fulness and pressure in forehead or vertex ; < or renewed when thinking thereof.
Pain in forehead as if a band about an inch wide were drawn across it from temple to temple.
Pressing pain in one or both temples (in a small spot) ; "a burning sensation" in top and front of head, > by motion and mental exertion, < when either is desisted from.
Pressure from within upwards to vertex, < by looking steadily at any fixed point.
Pain in occiput, with pulsative pain in vertex, vertigo, < stooping.
Uterine and hysterical headache.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Helon.]
Expression of suffering.
Pale, earthy face.
Face swollen.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Helon.]
Bitter, disagreeable taste, every morning, 5 A. M., on awaking ; lips, tongue and fauces dry.
Tongue white. θ Diabetes.
Tongue red at tip and borders, white in centre.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Helon.]
Salivation of pregnant women and teething children.
Mouth gets sore ; stomatitis materna.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Helon.]
Loss of appetite, eructations, fulness, cramp, and painful congestion of stomach.
Appetite poor, food tasteless ; "bilious ;" sleepy during day.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Helon.]
Empty eructations.
Tasteless eructations and flatulence, causing nausea.
Nausea at supper.
Vomiting of food. θ Dropsy.
Obstinate vomiting in Bright's disease.
